title.en: A clearer shared browser in your workspace
title.zh: 工作区共享浏览器更清晰易用

description.en: Switch pages from a single tab strip, create browser tabs from the new dialog, and see agent activity in a familiar browser layout.
description.zh: 通过统一的标签栏切换页面，在新建对话框中创建浏览器标签页，并在熟悉的浏览器布局中查看智能体活动。

title.en: Keep your unsent chat draft when switching views
title.zh: 切换侧栏视图时保留未发送的聊天草稿

title.en: Waiting replies no longer show the wrong agent
title.zh: 等待回复时不再显示错误的智能体

description.en: When the responding agent is uncertain, the waiting indicator stays neutral until the reply arrives.
description.zh: 无法确定由哪个智能体回复时，等待提示不再提前标注智能体身份。

title.en: Account sign-in is respected when running agents
title.zh: 智能体运行时正确使用账号登录

description.en: Agents configured with account sign-in use that session even when an older API key is saved. Readiness checks also use each agent's own credentials.
description.zh: 通过账号登录配置的智能体会使用该登录会话，不再被旧 API 密钥覆盖；就绪检查也使用各智能体自身的凭据。
